changelog: Two fixes: a subtitle cue whose own duration is exactly 2 seconds keeps that duration instead of being stretched to the next cue, and the index page's response is handed back correctly on every path (a non-HTML reply, an already-injected page, or an error) so an error page can still be written
description: Synchronize subtitles with video audio using ffsubsync
name: SubSync
overview: Adds a Sync Subtitles action to any video, using ffsubsync as backend
